name: Deploy to Production Server

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Environment to deploy to'
        required: true
        default: 'production'
        type: choice
        options:
          - production
          - staging

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Deploying to Production Server
    runs-on: [self-hosted, production-vm]
    environment: ${{ github.event.inputs.environment || 'production' }}
    
    env:
      PROJECT_NAME: testapp-prod
      HOST_PORT: 80
      COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME: testapp-prod-stack
      
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          clean: false
          
      - name: Create environment file
        run: |
          cat > .env << EOF
          MONGODB_URI=${{ secrets.MONGODB_URI }}
          PORT=5000
          JWT_SECRET=${{ secrets.JWT_SECRET }}
          REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
          REDIS_PASSWORD=${{ secrets.REDIS_PASSWORD }}
          NODE_ENV=production
          EOF
          
      - name: Create backup of current deployment
        run: |
          if docker-compose -p $COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME ps -q app > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Creating backup of current deployment..."
            docker tag ${PROJECT_NAME}_app:latest ${PROJECT_NAME}_app:backup-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S) || true
          fi
          
      - name: Stop existing services gracefully
        run: |
          if docker-compose -p $COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME ps -q > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Stopping existing services..."
            docker-compose -p $COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME stop
            sleep 10
            docker-compose -p $COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME down
          fi
          
      - name: Build and start services
        run: |
          docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml -p $COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME up -d --build
          
      - name: Wait for services to be ready
        run: |
          echo "Waiting for services to start..."
          sleep 45
          
          # Check if app is responding
          for i in {1..15}; do
            if curl -f http://localhost:$HOST_PORT/health; then
              echo "✅ Application is healthy!"
              break
            else
              echo "⏳ Waiting for application... (attempt $i/15)"
              if [ $i -eq 15 ]; then
                echo "❌ Application failed to start properly"
                docker-compose -p $COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME logs app
                exit 1
              fi
              sleep 15
            fi
          done
          
      - name: Run health checks
        run: |
          echo "=== Comprehensive Health Check ==="
          
          # Application health
          HEALTH_RESPONSE=$(curl -s http://localhost:$HOST_PORT/health)
          echo "Health Response: $HEALTH_RESPONSE"
          
          # Check if MongoDB is connected
          if echo "$HEALTH_RESPONSE" | jq -e '.services.mongodb == "connected"' > /dev/null; then
            echo "✅ MongoDB connection: OK"
          else
            echo "❌ MongoDB connection: FAILED"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check if Redis is connected
          if echo "$HEALTH_RESPONSE" | jq -e '.services.redis == "connected"' > /dev/null; then
            echo "✅ Redis connection: OK"
          else
            echo "⚠️ Redis connection: WARNING (app will continue without cache)"
          fi
          
          # Test API endpoints
          echo "=== API Endpoint Tests ==="
          
          # Test auth endpoint
          if curl -f -s http://localhost:$HOST_PORT/api/auth/login -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}' > /dev/null; then
            echo "✅ Auth endpoint: Accessible"
          else
            echo "❌ Auth endpoint: FAILED"
            exit 1
          fi
          
      - name: View deployment status
        run: |
          echo "=== Final Deployment Status ==="
          docker-compose -p $COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME ps
          
          echo "=== Resource Usage ==="
          docker stats --no-stream --format "table {{.Container}}\t{{.CPUPerc}}\t{{.MemUsage}}\t{{.MemPerc}}"
          
          echo "=== Recent Application Logs ==="
          docker-compose -p $COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME logs --tail=30 app
          
      - name: Clean up old resources
        run: |
          # Remove old backup images (keep last 3)
          docker images ${PROJECT_NAME}_app --format "{{.Tag}}" | grep backup | sort -r | tail -n +4 | xargs -r docker rmi ${PROJECT_NAME}_app: || true
          
          # Clean up unused resources
          docker system prune -f --volumes
          
      - name: Send deployment notification
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ "${{ job.status }}" == "success" ]; then
            echo "🚀 Deployment successful! Application is running at http://localhost:$HOST_PORT"
          else
            echo "❌ Deployment failed! Check the logs above for details."
          fi
